linux_cpu_ci.real_round_acceptance: Use 1B actual FedAvg server.run and two spawned simple.Client processes, one CPU SGD round, comm_simulation=false, deterministic distinct local datasets of 2 and 6 samples, ordinary processors/serialization and sockets, no downloads/S3. Require two distinct IDs/PIDs, changed client parameters, matched actual received payloads and reports, and final tensors equal to W0 + sum(n_i*(Wi-W0))/sum(n_i), rtol=1e-5/atol=1e-6. Snapshot tensors before mutation. No fake reports, StaticTrainingStrategy or direct aggregation substitute.
linux_cpu_ci.bounds: Keep 1B 90-second real-round deadline with per-run port/root and child PID/start-time tracking. Normal success requires natural process disappearance and released port; watchdog kills cannot pass. Failure/stall cases preserve original error markers, TERM then KILL owned group/descendants within 5+5 seconds, reap and assert no survivors. Keep 1B 30+5+5 containment bounds for deliberate teardown stalls. Process exit via existing os._exit is not proof of finally execution; separate entrypoint regressions prove cooperative loop cleanup.
